title: High quality snacks
text:
While everything was very well packaged and of good quality the amount is a bit packing for the price.

Love trying new things so this should be perfect for me. I got so little in the first box that I almost unsubscribed the day it arrived. I hung on for another month and the snacks were slightly more plentiful but still not enough for the money. I unsubscribed after the second box.
label: positive
